commercial_courts.description: Constitution of Commercial Courts, Commercial Divisions, Specified Value adjudication, and Mandatory Pre-Institution Mediation (PIMS § 12A).

arbitration.description: Domestic arbitration, international commercial arbitration, interim relief (§ 9, § 17), challenge to arbitral awards (§ 34), and execution (§ 36).

limitation.description: Statutory computation of limitation periods, condonation of delay (§ 5), exclusion of time spent in good faith / mediation (§ 12, § 14, § 12A CCA), and Schedule articles.

cpc.description: Procedural law governing Indian civil and commercial courts, interlocutory attachments (Order 38 Rule 5), injunctions (Order 39), and pleadings (Order 6 & 7).

contract_act.description: General principles of commercial contract, breach of contract (§ 73, § 74), indemnity, guarantee (§ 126, § 128), and agency (§ 182).

ni_act.description: Cheques, promissory notes, bills of exchange, and criminal dishonour of cheques (§ 138 to § 148).

ibc.description: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP § 7, 9, 10), Liquidation (§ 33), Avoidance transactions (§ 43, 45, 50, 66), and Pre-Pack (§ 54A).

companies_act.description: Corporate governance, board powers (§ 179, § 180), related party transactions (§ 188), compromises and arrangements (§ 230-232), and oppression/mismanagement (§ 241).

commercial_recovery_suite.title: Commercial Court & Debt Recovery Suite
commercial_recovery_suite.description: Complete statutory suite for commercial suits, summary suits, attachment before judgment, interim injunctions, and Section 12A PIMS mediation.

insolvency_restructuring_suite.title: Insolvency & Corporate Restructuring Suite
insolvency_restructuring_suite.target_market: Insolvency Professionals, NCLT Advocates, Committee of Creditors
insolvency_restructuring_suite.description: Statutory suite for CIRP, liquidation, avoidance inquests (§§ 43, 45, 50, 66), Section 29A due diligence, and Companies Act corporate governance.

arbitration_adr_suite.title: Arbitration & Commercial Mediation Suite
arbitration_adr_suite.description: Statutory suite for domestic/international arbitration, Section 9 interim measures, Section 34 challenge petitions, and Mediation Act 2023 settlements.
